    Settings

    Setup guide

    Runs the first-time setup and the tour again. Your current settings are filled in.

    Appearance

    Auto follows your phone. Your choice is saved to your account.

    Your profile

    Photos

    Photos are visible to the group. Large photos are resized automatically.

    Workout logging

    When on, what you enter for a set fills in the empty sets below it for that exercise. Warm-up sets are skipped, and you can still change any set.

    If you don't hear it, turn up your phone's media volume. The sound can't play while your screen is locked.

    Service record

    Saves right away. Sets your age for your calorie plan and your age bracket in the weekly challenges.

    BMR is the calories your body burns at rest. If you know yours from a DEXA, InBody or metabolic test, enter it here and your calorie plan will use it instead of the estimate.

    Update your weight here as it changes so your calorie plan stays accurate.

    Your goal and calorie plan

    Your suggested calories and macros are shown in Daily calorie and macro targets below.

    Daily calorie and macro targets

    A starting estimate from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, adjusted for activity and your goal. It is not medical advice. Check with your doctor before major diet or training changes. Adjust as your weight and energy respond.

    Protein
    Carbs
    Fat

    Your calorie goal will change

    Private to you. Slide to adjust, or let Your goal and calorie plan fill them in. Protein and carbs are 4 kcal per gram, fat is 9.

    Daily reminders

    Your times are saved now. Notifications turn on when the mobile app launches.

    Health data

    Privacy and safety

    Keep it real. No judgment, no gossip. What is shared here stays here. Your food, water, targets and body stats are private. The group sees your checked boxes, points, PRs, motto and posts.

    Blocked

    You have not blocked anyone.

    Concern about a post or a brother? Use Report on the post, or contact your group leader. A public support email gets added before the app store launch.

    Testing: change the date

    Anything you log while testing is saved to that date for real. Delete test entries when you are done.

    Delete your data

    Delete my data Permanently removes your checkins, habits, food, water and workout logs, targets, profile, posts, likes and uploaded photos from this app. It cannot be undone.

    Forged & Sent is a fitness and accountability tool, not medical advice.
